Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in interpreting the chronological data. While the birthdates for both individuals (Nicolas G rtler: March 8, 1990; Michel de Salzmann: December 31, 1923) were correctly gathered, the Planner concluded that Michel de Salzmann, born in 1923, is younger than Nicolas G rtler, born in 1990. This error occurred because the Planner misapplied the comparative logic necessary to determine which date/year indicated greater youth. The decision directly contradicts the factual evidence gathered, signaling a failure in reasoning during synthesis of the data.
